system.description:
Athlete. +1 Talent Die on feats of athleticism such as running, jumping and climbing.

Cocky (Flaw). When a failed Skill Check ticks the Doom Clock forward, tick it 1 extra minute for each Strange symbol rolled.

SHIVER Core Rulebook p.81
